children: Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN, Financials) has been constructing a delivery network for years that allows it more control over how shipments arrive at customers. Now portion of that network is under investigation.
A Boeing 767 belonging to Amazon Air went off a runway at Miami International Airport, hitting cars and catching fire. It was not Amazon operating the plane, but 21 Air.
First, the human cost of the accident. The bigger worries for investors are around the inquiry and if it culminates in operational adjustments for Amazon's air network.
Amazon Air has emerged as a key aspect of the company's push to get items to customers more quickly without relying completely on outside carriers. Which makes reliability vital.

One mishap alone is unlikely to impact the profitability of Amazon's logistics operation. But any such inspections, limits or modifications to fly operations could incur additional expenses or delays.
Investigators will now try to discover the reason of the disaster, and whether bigger adjustments are needed.

title: Amazon Cargo Jet Crash Puts Its Air Network in the Spotlight
